items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Dr. Steele kept us up on -- he was a doctor of music. He'd make you play. You had to play around him. People sitting in the band like Steel and Hilton Jefferson and those guys

ctx.x: Some other arrangers write different stuff never recorded, but we had a lot of music. A lot of pop stuff.
Melodies of waltzes, melodies of -- Like I say, we had tangos and Dr. Steele kept us up on -- he was a doctor of music. He'd make you play.
You had to play around him. People sitting in the band like Steel and Hilton Jefferson and those guys -- those were the top musicians.
